```\n413\t#[allow(dead_code)]\n414\tfn assertion_test() {\n415\t    let (latencies, median) = measure_median_latency_100kb();\n416\t    let threshold = latency_threshold_ms();\n417\t\n418\t    // p95);\n432\t    eprintln!(\"  Max:     {} ms\", max);\n433\t    eprintln!(\"  Threshold: {} ms\", threshold);\n434\t\n435\t    assert!(\n436\t        median < threshold,\n437\t        \"Sanitizer
